model: Vaxign-ML (stock pretrained model, trained on all of Protegen)
about: Real Vaxign-ML output for the 40 proteins of fixtures/nmb_fixture (Gram-negative mode), made on 2026-11-14 with the Docker image above, CPU, on an Apple-silicon Mac. The score is Vaxign-ML's protegenicity PERCENTILE (0-100), hence scale 100; it is not a probability. Columns are the raw 'sample' and 'protegenicity' of the tool's result file, unchanged.
warning: The stock model was trained on all of Protegen, which contains N. meningitidis antigens (fHbp, NadA, NHBA among them). Do not present their high scores as validation; holdout_enforced is false so S3 raises its LEAKAGE RISK warning.
use: s3.backend: scores_file and s3.scores_file: docs/examples/vaxign_ml_scores.nmb_fixture.tsv (the .meta.json next to it is read automatically)
